name: Maximum Degree of Tagged Singletons
details: For the displayed tagged-singletons formula and the usual asymptotic range of $n$; the legacy $n/2$ entry omitted the tag-allocation offset.
proof: The $1$-inclusion graph has an edge from $\emptyset$ to every tag singleton, and an edge from the tag singleton $\{n+\ell\}$ to each tagged pair carrying tag $\ell$.  For $\ell=1$, the definition of $f$ assigns exactly $\lfloor n/2\rfloor+\lceil\log n\rceil+1$ ordinary coordinates to that tag.  Its degree is therefore $\lfloor n/2\rfloor+\lceil\log n\rceil+2$.  Later tag groups are smaller, every tagged pair has degree one, and the empty concept has only $\lceil\log n\rceil$ neighbours, proving this is the maximum.
